metadata.methods_description: Mobile EEG was recorded during three tasks: (1) Eyes open/closed standing for 1 minute each, repeated twice in counterbalanced order; (2) Oddball task with 800 and 1000 Hz tones during standing, walking alone, and walking with experimenter around an outdoor basketball arena (5-6 minute blocks, repeated twice); (3) Walking with experimenter in three conditions (natural, control with side-blinders, and synchronized walking) for 6 minutes each. All participants completed sessions with both active and passive electrodes in counterbalanced order.
